title: MLEvidence input v1
description: Domain evidence payload for the ML adapter's validate_claim. kind classifies what produced the evidence; experiment_run (one possibly repeated-seed experiment study) alone drives the maturity ceiling together with data_provenance, the recorded UNIQUE seed set, and the frozen-holdout flag, while the four assessment kinds of task 7 — calibration, subgroup, OOD, drift — each recorded as its own evidence item, feed the gap-naming rules and never lift the ceiling by themselves (ADR-0008 decisions 4/6 and addendum A2). study_id binds the item to one study; the adapter fails closed on a claim/evidence study mismatch. The schema fixes only the vocabularies; it never grants maturity.

study_id.description: Study this evidence belongs to; validate_claim fails closed when it differs from the claim's study_id (claim and evidence must be bound to one study — ADR-0008 addendum A2).

kind.description: What produced this evidence item. experiment_run is one (possibly repeated-seed) experiment study; the four assessment kinds carry the calibration, subgroup, out-of-distribution, and drift evaluations of task 7, one item each.

data_provenance.description: Data the evidence rests on: synthetic (engineered data proving pipeline behavior only), public (public datasets), real (real, de-identified data). empirically_supported requires public or real evidence; all-synthetic evidence caps at data_accepted.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the underlying artifact (run log, report file, audit export). Binds the evidence payload to a concrete artifact.

seeds.description: Random seeds the evidence was produced under (task 6). An explicit empty array declares a non-random artifact. Single-seed experiment evidence caps a generalization claim at engineering_verified (a single-seed best value cannot support a stable claim).

frozen_holdout.description: True only if the evidence was produced on a frozen, untouched holdout partition. empirically_supported requires it; absence caps generalization claims below the tier without fabricating conclusions.

limitations.description: Known limitations of this evidence. Required; explicit empty array only after consideration.
